newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Wool International sells warehouse for A$28.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Wool International sells warehouse for A$28.5 mln.

text.p: Wool International (WI) had sold its Gillman warehouse in South Australia for A$28.5 million, WI said in a statement.
Dick Warburton, chairman of the authority which manages the sale of Australia's wool stockpile, said the estate comprised eleven warehouses on 30 hectares of land close to Port Adelaide.
The majority of the estate was leased to non-wool industry tenants. WI would lease back space for stockpile wool, he said.
Sale of the estate has left WI with one property asset, Wool House in Melbourne.
The sale completed the disposal of WI's warehouses, which have netted A$300 million in sale proceeds.
It was proposed to distribute the proceeds to woolgrowers in 1999 after repayment of debt, Warburton said.
